import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        long a = -1;
        long b = 1; // Initialize b to avoid division by zero in comparison
        for (long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long j = i * x / y;
            if (i * x - j * y > (j + 1) * y - i * x) {
                j++;
            }
            if (a == -1 || Math.abs(j * y - i * x) * b < Math.abs(a * y - b * x) * i) {
                a = j;
                b = i;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(a + "/" + b);
        sc.close();
    }
}
